Question
========
Which capability does Quarto have that plain Markdown lacks?

Answerlist
----------
* Formatting text with headings and lists.
* Executing code and embedding the resulting output in a document.
* Adding hyperlinks to a document.
* Applying bold or italic emphasis to text.

Solution
========

Answerlist
----------
* Wrong: heading and list formatting is a core Markdown feature, available without Quarto.
* Correct: Markdown has no computation layer; Quarto adds the ability to execute code and embed dynamic results.
* Wrong: hyperlinks are supported by Markdown alone.
* Wrong: emphasis (bold/italic) is a core Markdown feature.
